name: Oats Tikki
steps: Dry-toast the oats until lightly fragrant; pulse only half to coarse crumbs so the finished tikki still shows flakes.
Cook peas until tender, drain dry and lightly crush; mash the potatoes separately.
Combine oats, potato, peas, chopped onion, coriander, chili, ginger, cumin and salt; rest until oats absorb moisture.
Shape compact patties; if the mixture feels sticky, let it stand longer instead of adding extra flour.
Pan-fry in a thin layer of oil over medium heat until both sides are crisp and brown; serve with mint chutney.
tips: Keeping some oats whole gives texture; finely grinding all of them makes a dense, pasty patty.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
